name: listValueCount
description:
Counts instances of a specified value in a list. The search is
case-sensitive.
syntax: listValueCount( string list, string value, [string delimiter], [boolean includeEmptyFields] )

params.name: delimiter
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if set to true, empty values are included as well
